Goal
* Please make the following changes:

  • Celsius => Celsius (C)

  • an other => another

  • unity => unit

  • Rankin => Rankine

* Please use either × or * consistently.

* Please use either fractions or decimals consistently:

  • F: Use 9/5 or 1.8

  • Ra: Use 9/5 or 1.8

  • Re: Use 4/5 or 0.8

Constraints
* The first constraint is incorrect as some [[t]] values are negative.

* Please change "final" to "converted".

* Please move the second constraint to the Output section.

Game modes
* Please disable Reverse mode. Players shouldn't be expected to know or look up the conversion formulas in this mode.

Cases
* All current tests use 2-digit integer inputs. Please update them to cover a broader range of temperatures, including values with 1 to 5 digits, both positive and negative.

Thanks.

IN "Goal"
Convert Ra = (C + 273.15) × 1.8 to Ra = (C + 273.15) * 1.8.
And specifies {{C}} for Celsius
Thanks
